findings.label: live-budget-contradiction
findings.summary: The live targets cannot satisfy both the shaping budget and the 600 s case budget.
findings.detail: The contract requires up to 5 minutes of Shaper interaction plus 10 minutes autonomous (15 minutes total), while live-shaping-quality cases have a 600 s budget. The same package permits up to two 180 s auditor runs plus 60 s Jev per stop, and records prior runs of roughly 400–490 s before audit. A valid full-flow case can therefore exceed 600 s by construction. Fix by choosing one exact compatible budget/profile/observable contract, or explicitly make the live scenario observe a bounded subset rather than claiming the full flow.

findings.label: auditor-profile-mismatch
findings.summary: The selected live fixtures use fast low profiles that do not exercise the mandated route auditor profiles.
findings.detail: The direction requires Claude routes to use Claude Opus 5.5 high and Codex routes to use gpt-6-sol high as the adversarial auditor. The paid-target risk instead says both live fixtures force gpt-6-luna low / claude-sonnet-5 low, and explicitly says the runs prove only launch path, not the auditor's judgement. That leaves the auditor-setting/blind-auditor claims unproven by the selected live targets. Fix by using the mandated auditor profiles, or narrow the scenario and remove the claim that these targets validate the auditor layer.

findings.label: shaper-worker-contract-gap
findings.summary: The stated Shaper-worker write contract contradicts the supplied harness implementation and lacks an exact required change.
findings.detail: The Intent's assumptions and process say Shaper workers may edit their assigned Draft files, but lib/kogen/harness/claude.ex only grants Edit/Write to role "developer"; every non-Developer worker, including "shaper", is explicitly read-only. This reproduces the session failure the Intent claims to fix. Fix the scenario's exact solution and tests to grant narrowly assigned Shaper writes (with the stated boundaries), or remove the write requirement and its promised fix.
